candidate.title: Migration uses `force: true`, risking silent table drop and data loss on re-run
reports: migrations createtoptopics.rb:3 and createtopicembeds.rb:3 use force: true, silently dropping existing tables and data; editing already-shipped migrations is a red flag

p3: unrelated churn bundled in the diff, including force: true added to an already-shipped migration (data-loss hazard on re-run), whitespace edits, and the disqus thor task losing its --category option

[bug] createtable :topicembeds, force: true bakes a drop table if exists into the migration, so once the table holds production data any re-run silently destroys the embedurl-to-topic mapping. after this ships, a re-run triggered by a schemamigrations/restore mismatch drops every topicembeds row; topicembed.topicidforembed then returns nil for known urls, so the next retrieve/poll re-imports each article and creates a duplicate topic while the original topic and its replies remain on the forum, doubling content until the mapping is manually rebuilt.
